top.line: Sell to the companies that already have the problem
top.para: Start from the business problem, when the company has built its own app; the breakage teaches non-functional requirements; at the handover, regional villager companies productise what was built, with the model still the editor.

in-short.para: Matching; when to start; encourage mini apps; the crash course; the handover; villager companies; sell to the problem.

problem.para: Algarve Evolution wants to match companies adopting AI with providers, starting from the problem, not the technology; start when the brief is finished.

brief.line: The brief is now an app
brief.para: With AI a spreadsheet becomes an application built by the people who know the work: explorer coding, where the app is the specification.

mess.para: Events and teaching that get companies building mini apps with a model they own; they love them, and then they break, a crash course in backups, change control and security.

handover.para: The builder has a day job, and now five, ten or fifty people need the app: the moment a company is ready to buy.

villagers.para: Providers that productise what the company built, robust, secure and scalable, with the model still the editor; selling to people who already have the problem, then everything else.

who.para: Micro and small businesses and the person willing to learn; a network of providers; events, a provider map and introductions at the handover.

limits.para: A proposal; António's words not quoted; the breakage a prediction; not every company builds; my interest.
